_doc: L3-COUNTRY normalization layer. Every corridor inherits its country's opex + cost_index. Sourced once per country, reused across all corridors in that country. cost_index = relative price level vs Singapore=1.00, used by the estimation cascade to scale regional-median fares into un-sourced corridors. All values carry source_tier + confidence.

_schema.captain_usd_yr: fully-loaded annual crew cost for one vessel (1 captain + deckhand blended)
_schema.grid_co2_kg_kwh: grid carbon intensity for charging-emissions calc

captain_usd_yr.source: ERI SalaryExpert boat captain PH ~PHP825,644/yr (~$14.5k @57). Blended 1 captain + local deckhand (~PHP15-22k/mo, Indeed) for one commercial tourism vessel ~$15k fully-loaded.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Meralco 2025 overall ~PHP11-12.26/kWh (highest tariff in SEA); commercial/general-power class ~PHP11/kWh = ~$0.20 @57.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Coal-heavy PH grid; Climatiq 0.691 kgCO2/kWh, PH DOE National Grid Emission Factor ~0.65-0.71.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr; below Thailand ($12k) on lower PH marine-ops costs.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.31x SG (captain $15k vs $48k) but electricity ~0.95x SG ($0.20 vs $0.21); blended ~0.50, in line with Indonesia 0.45 / Thailand 0.55.

captain_usd_yr.source: ERI SalaryExpert Vietnam boat captain avg ~VND 540M/yr (~$21k @26,300, high-side professional). Blended 1 tourism-boat captain + local deckhand realistically lower; Vietnam wage band ~= Philippines/Indonesia. Fully-loaded ~$14k/vessel/yr.

energy_usd_kwh.source: EVN avg retail VND 2,204/kWh ($0.084, May 2025). Commercial/services sector (kinh doanh) pays the HIGHEST tariff band: normal-hour ~VND 3,200/kWh ($0.12), peak up to VND 5,422 ($0.21, VietnamNet 2025). Tourism boat operators are on services tariff -> ~$0.12.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Vietnam official grid emission factor 2023 = 0.6592 tCO2/MWh (MOIT/Dept of Climate Change; down from 0.6766 in 2022). Coal+hydro+gas mix.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Below Thailand ($12k), ~= Indonesia/Philippines ($10k) on lower Vietnam marine-ops costs.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.29x SG (captain $14k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.57x SG ($0.12 vs $0.21); blended ~0.45, in line with Indonesia 0.45, below Thailand 0.55.

captain_usd_yr.source: No clean Cambodia boat-captain salary index. Cambodia wage band sits just below Vietnam/Philippines (lower GDP/capita). Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain + local deckhand fully-loaded ~$11k/vessel/yr (captain ~$600-800/mo + deckhand ~$250-350/mo incl on-costs). Below Vietnam $14k / Philippines $15k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: EDC commercial/business tariff. Climatescope 2025: Cambodia avg electricity price ~$137/MWh (2023) -> ~$149/MWh (2024) = ~$0.15/kWh. ERIA: EDC grid tariffs range US cents 9-25/kWh, commercial band ~18-23c historically. GlobalPetrolPrices business ~$0.147/kWh. Among the higher commercial tariffs in SEA (heavy diesel/coal + imports). Anchored $0.15.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Cambodia grid mix ~coal 45-50% + hydro ~30-40% + imports ~15% + small solar. Average consumption intensity ~0.5-0.6 kgCO2/kWh. NOTE: marginal/operating-margin factor is far higher (IFI OM ~1.046 kgCO2/kWh, coal-on-margin with must-run hydro). Used average grid intensity 0.6 for charging-emissions; below Vietnam 0.66 / PH 0.68 / Indonesia 0.75 due to hydro share.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr for Sihanoukville marine ops; ~= Vietnam $9k, below Thailand $12k on lower Cambodia operating costs.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.23x SG (captain $11k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.71x SG ($0.15 vs $0.21); blended ~0.42, just below Vietnam/Indonesia (0.45) and well below Thailand (0.55). R7 two-sided: cheap crew but high (dollarized) electricity keeps the index from going lower.

captain_usd_yr.source: ERI ship captain RM119k/yr (high-side professional); Indeed boat-captain avg RM2,885/mo (~RM35k/yr); Jobstreet Sabah boat captain RM5.5-8k/mo (offshore high-side). Tourism island-boat captain ~RM3-4k/mo + deckhand ~RM1.8-2k/mo, blended fully-loaded (incl EPF/SOCSO) ~RM73k = $17k @4.30. Above Indonesia/PH/VN (higher MY min wage RM1,700), below Thailand $24k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: TNB low-voltage Commercial tariff ~36.5 sen/kWh base; July-2025 restructure base 45.4 sen/kWh; effective all-in commercial (incl AFA/capacity) ~RM0.40-0.45/kWh = $0.09-0.10 @4.30. Sabah SESB similar band. Anchored $0.10. Below Thailand $0.116, above Indonesia $0.07.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Peninsular Malaysia grid coal+gas heavy: Energy Commission GEF ~0.758 kgCO2/kWh (2021, used by UM); Climatiq 0.792. Sabah (SESB) grid lower (more gas/hydro/diesel). National blended ~0.70. Coal-heavy Peninsular pulls it up; below Indonesia 0.75.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Between Thailand ($12k) and PH/Indonesia ($10k); Malaysia marina ops (Sutera Harbour, Telaga, Jesselton) mid-cost. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.35x SG (captain $17k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.48x SG ($0.10 vs $0.21); blended ~0.55, ~= Thailand 0.55 and above Indonesia/VN/PH (0.45-0.50). R7 two-sided: higher MY wages but cheaper (subsidized) power -> mid-tier index.

captain_usd_yr.source: ERI SalaryExpert Taiwan boat captain NT$1,639,415/yr (~$50.8k @32.3, high-side single qualified captain). Blended 1 tourism-boat captain (~NT$55-65k/mo) + deckhand (~NT$35-40k/mo) fully-loaded (incl labor insurance/pension) ~NT$1.23M = ~$38k/vessel/yr. Taiwan is high-income (GDP/cap ~$33k); 2nd-highest wage in set, below Singapore $48k, well above Thailand $24k / SEA $11-17k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Taipower 2025: industrial NT$4.27/kWh (unchanged, Taipei Times); residential ~NT$3.23 ($0.10); GlobalPetrolPrices business band TWD7.29 ($0.232, Sep 2025). A small tourism boat is on the 表燈營業 (commercial lighting) tariff - the higher band (R7-EXT) - effective blended ~NT$5-6/kWh = ~$0.18 @32.3. Floor industrial $0.13, ceiling commercial-business $0.23.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Taipower official electricity carbon emission factor: 0.467 kgCO2/kWh (2024), 2025 preliminary 0.456 (MOEA/Energy-Omni). Coal+LNG heavy with nuclear phase-out but notably cleaner than SEA neighbors (0.46 vs VN 0.66 / PH 0.68 / Indonesia 0.75). 2025 target 0.388.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Taiwan high-income marine ops (Kaohsiung/Penghu/Donggang); above Thailand $12k / Malaysia $11k, below Singapore $20k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.79x SG (captain $38k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.86x SG ($0.18 vs $0.21); blended ~0.72. Highest in the set after Singapore - Taiwan is a high-income economy, not a low-cost SEA market. R7 two-sided: high wages AND mid-high commercial power both pull the index up.

captain_usd_yr.source: GCC expat marine crew. Job ads (Instagram/Facebook 2026): yacht/boat captain SAR 7,000-10,000/mo (~$1,870-2,670/mo); ERI SalaryExpert boat captain avg SAR 203,728/yr (~$54k, high-side single qualified). Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain (~SAR 8,500/mo) + deckhand (~SAR 3,500/mo) fully-loaded (housing/food/visa typically provided) ~= SAR 157k = ~$42k/vessel/yr @3.75. High-income GCC; just below Singapore $48k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: HEAVILY SUBSIDIZED. SEC/SERA commercial tariff: SAR 0.22/kWh up to 6,000 kWh/mo, SAR 0.32 above (clenergize/SEC 2025). GlobalPetrolPrices business SAR 0.277 = $0.074 (Sep 2025). Anchored $0.074. Floor (low-band) ~$0.059, ceiling (high-band SAR 0.32) ~$0.085. @SAR 3.75 (pegged).

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Saudi DNA official grid emission factor 0.568 tCO2/MWh (KFUPM 2024 GHG inventory citing DNA CDM); IEA-derived 0.56 (KSU 2024); ACWA Power 0.520; ScienceDirect ~0.65. Gas+oil-fired grid. Anchored 0.57.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. New premium Red Sea Global / NEOM marinas (Shura, Sindalah 86-berth) are high-cost GCC marine ops; above Taiwan $14k, below Singapore $20k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.875x SG (captain $42k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.35x SG ($0.074 vs $0.21, heavily subsidized). R7 two-sided: HIGH GCC crew cost but very cheap subsidized power -> wage-weighted blend ~0.68. High-income GCC; below Singapore, just below Taiwan 0.72.

captain_usd_yr.source: GCC expat marine crew, slightly below Saudi. Job ads (Instagram 2026): private boat captain BHD 250-350/mo (~$660-930/mo). Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain (~BHD 1,000/mo ~$2,650) + deckhand (~BHD 400/mo ~$1,060) fully-loaded (visa/accom provided) ~= ~$36k/vessel/yr @BHD 0.376. High-income GCC; just below Saudi $42k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: SUBSIDIZED. EWA non-subsidized (expat/commercial) rate 32 fils/kWh = BHD 0.032 = ~$0.085 (GulfInsider/Reddit 2026). GlobalPetrolPrices business BHD 0.029 = $0.077 (Sep 2025). Anchored $0.08. @BHD 0.376 (pegged).

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Bahrain grid is ~100% natural gas (some oil), efficient CCGT. No single official GEF found; GCC gas grids ~0.45-0.60 kgCO2/kWh (Kuwait oil-heavy 0.69 is upper bound, IEA). Anchored 0.55 - gas-dominated. Tagged med.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Bahrain marine ops (Manama/Marina) mid-high GCC; below Saudi $18k, above Taiwan $14k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.75x SG (captain $36k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.38x SG ($0.08 vs $0.21, subsidized). R7 two-sided: high GCC crew, cheap subsidized power -> wage-weighted blend ~0.63, just below Saudi 0.68.

captain_usd_yr.source: GCC expat marine crew (Dubai). Dubai yacht-group ads: captain AED 5,000-10,000/mo, deckhand AED 2,000-3,500/mo; Morgan & Mallet GCC guide captain $4,200-7,200/mo, deckhand $1,550-2,300/mo. Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain (~AED 8,000/mo ~$2,180) + deckhand (~AED 3,000/mo ~$817) fully-loaded incl visa/accommodation/insurance ~= ~$40k/vessel/yr @AED 3.6725. High-income GCC; between Saudi $42k and Bahrain $36k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: DEWA commercial slab tariff AED 0.23/0.28/0.32 per kWh + ~6 fils fuel surcharge (DEWA 2025); utilitybilluae.com business band AED 0.20-0.38/kWh. Effective commercial ~AED 0.30-0.33 = ~$0.082-0.090 @AED 3.6725. Abu Dhabi (ADDC) commercial cheaper. Blended UAE commercial ~$0.085. Subsidized like other GCC but above Saudi $0.074.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: UAE grid emission factor FALLING: Climatiq 0.404 kgCO2/kWh (recent); GE Vernova white paper 0.556 (2021) -> target 0.27 by 2030. Driven down by Barakah nuclear (4 units, ~25% of generation) + large solar (Mohammed bin Rashid / Al Dhafra). Anchored 0.40 - cleanest GCC grid in the set (vs Saudi 0.57, Bahrain 0.55).

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Dubai premium marinas (Dubai Marina, Dubai Harbour, Bluewaters) are among the most expensive GCC marine ops; above Saudi $18k and Singapore $20k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.83x SG (captain $40k vs $48k); commercial electricity ~0.40x SG ($0.085 vs $0.21, subsidized). R7-GCC two-sided: HIGH GCC expat crew but cheap subsidized power -> wage-weighted blend ~0.74, plus Dubai's high general price level / premium marina overhead pull it up. Highest GCC in set (above Saudi 0.68, Bahrain 0.63), just above Taiwan 0.72 - Dubai is an expensive high-income market, NOT a low-cost band.

captain_usd_yr.source: Maldives resort/tourism marine crew (real 2026 job listings): MHLZ speedboat captain MVR 15,000 + MVR 3,000 food allowance = MVR 18k/mo; jobcenter.mv boat captain MVR 20,000-25,000 + service charge; expat safari/yacht captains EUR 3,200/mo (high-side). Blended 1 resort speedboat captain (~MVR 15-20k base + service charge/food ~$1,500-1,700/mo all-in) + deckhand (~MVR 10-12k all-in ~$700/mo) fully-loaded ~$2,250/mo = ~$27k/vessel/yr @MVR 15.42. Higher than SEA (service-charge system + some expat crew); between Thailand $24k and GCC $36-42k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Maldives has among the HIGHEST electricity costs in South Asia (near-100% imported diesel). STELCO Male' commercial tariff MVR 3.30/kWh = $0.214 (stelco.com.mv tariff-rates). Resort islands SELF-GENERATE on diesel gensets at $0.30-0.40/kWh (CIF SREP: diesel $0.35/kWh; World Bank 30-40 US-cents on larger islands; ADB/Climate Policy Radar efficient-diesel $0.23-0.33). Charging an electric tourism boat will largely occur at diesel-powered resort islands -> anchored $0.30 (floor STELCO grid $0.214, ceiling resort diesel $0.40). Higher than Singapore $0.21.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Maldives generation is ~99% imported diesel/fuel-oil (small but growing solar). Diesel-genset grids ~0.70-0.78 kgCO2/kWh (IEA Emission Factors 2024; Climatiq Maldives grid). Anchored 0.72 - among the highest in the set (vs Indonesia 0.75, PH 0.68), driven by all-diesel island power. Solar push (SREP/AIIB) will lower this over time.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin per vessel/yr. Maldives is a high-cost island operating environment (everything imported; no true marinas - resort jetties/anchorage + maintenance + marine insurance). Above Thailand $12k / Malaysia $11k, near Taiwan $14k, below Singapore $20k / GCC $18-22k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. R7 two-sided: wages ~0.56x SG (captain $27k vs $48k) but commercial/operating electricity ~1.43x SG ($0.30 vs $0.21 - Maldives is MORE expensive on energy, all-diesel islands) plus very high imported-logistics price level. Wage-dominant blend nudged up by energy + import costs -> ~0.63. Above all SEA (0.42-0.55), below GCC/Taiwan (0.68-0.74). Maldives is an expensive tourism economy, not a low-cost band.

captain_usd_yr.source: GCC expat marine crew (Doha). Naukrigulf: yacht captain Qatar QAR 6,000-18,518/mo, avg QAR 10,333/mo (~$2,840); Indeed Qatar boat captain avg QAR 50,795/yr (low-side local base, ~$14k); Facebook/MCA ad: 38m-yacht captain $15k/mo (superyacht high-side, excluded). Deckhand: Doha job ads QAR 2,300/mo + food (Facebook 2026), Indeed boat/yacht crew up to QAR 4,500/mo. Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain (~QAR 10,000/mo ~$2,750) + deckhand (~QAR 3,000/mo ~$825) fully-loaded incl visa/accommodation ~= QAR 156k = ~$43k/vessel/yr @QAR 3.64 (pegged). Highest GCC wage market (GDP/cap top of GCC); just above Saudi $42k / UAE $40k, below Singapore $48k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: HEAVILY SUBSIDIZED - cheapest commercial power in the set. Kahramaa commercial tariff slabs: QAR 0.09/kWh first 4,000 kWh/mo, QAR 0.12 for 4,001-15,000, QAR 0.14 above 15,000 (Kahramaa tariff schedule). GlobalPetrolPrices business QAR 0.130/kWh = $0.036 (Sep 2025). Anchored $0.036. Floor (low slab QAR 0.09) ~$0.025, ceiling (top slab QAR 0.14) ~$0.038. @QAR 3.64 (pegged). Well below Saudi $0.074 / Bahrain $0.08 / UAE $0.085.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Qatar grid is ~100% natural gas (efficient CCGT; low-carbon share 0.24%). Ember/lowcarbonpower.org 2024: 489 gCO2eq/kWh; AYCM Qatar (official Doha carbon-footprint program) electricity factor 0.539 kgCO2/kWh; IEA/Climatiq Qatar grid factor in same band. Anchored 0.49 - all-gas grid, cleaner than oil-blend GCC peers (Saudi 0.57, Bahrain 0.55) but above nuclear+solar UAE 0.40. Renewables strategy targets -27% intensity by 2030 (Al Kharsaah solar).

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Doha premium marina set: Lusail Marina, The Pearl (Ronautica) marinas, Old Doha Port Mina District superyacht marina - high-cost GCC marine ops comparable to Dubai. Between Saudi $18k and UAE $22k, ~= Singapore $20k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~0.90x SG (captain $43k vs $48k - highest GCC crew cost); commercial electricity ~0.17x SG ($0.036 vs $0.21 - most heavily subsidized power in the set). R7-GCC two-sided: very high expat crew + ultra-cheap gas-subsidized power -> wage-weighted blend ~0.70, nudged up by Doha's high general price level / premium marinas. Sits between Saudi 0.68 and UAE 0.74, above Bahrain 0.63.

captain_usd_yr.source: Indeed.fr Tahiti: 'capitaine de navire' est. €2,454/mo (~$2,700/mo, ~$32k/yr base). CESEC PF avis 8-2023: marin pêcheur salaire moyen 280,000 XPF/mo (~$2,570). Premium tourism-boat captain XPF 380-450k/mo (~$3,500-4,150) + deckhand SMIG XPF 173,181 = $1,580 (Direction du travail, May-2024 SMIG). Fully-loaded 1 captain + deckhand incl French-territory social charges (~50% on top) ~XPF 6M/yr = ~$55k/vessel/yr @109. High French-overseas-territory wage band; sits below Singapore $48k... actually ABOVE on social charges (~$55k), between Taiwan $38k and Saudi $42k.

energy_usd_kwh.source: EDT-Engie Tahiti Nord 2024 tariff schedule (edt.pf official PDF Jan-2024): commercial/professional 'Usages professionnels' tranches 22.00, 23.30, 33.95, 37.00, 39.49, 40.64, 42.46 XPF/kWh HT depending on slab/voltage. Domestic tier 11.90/31.10 XPF/kWh. Blended commercial small tourism-boat operator ~35 XPF/kWh = ~$0.32 @109. Outer-island grids (Maupiti, Bora, Marquesas) similar or higher (~35-45 XPF/kWh) - diesel-dominated. Among the highest tariffs in the Pacific.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Bilan énergétique de la Polynésie française - édition 2024 (service-public.pf / SDE official): 'facteur d'émission moyen en Polynésie française est de 579 gCO2e/kWh en 2024' (vs 565 in 2021, 486 in 2022, 542 in 2023, 477 Tahiti, 894 Moorea). Generation mix 71% thermal (diesel) + 23% hydro (Marama Nui Tahiti) + ~6% solar (UNIDO PICTs 2022). Hydro share moderates the otherwise-diesel intensity. Anchored 0.58.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. FP is a high-cost French-overseas import-dependent island economy with limited marina infrastructure (Papeete Marina Taina, Vaitape jetties, Apooiti Marina Raiatea). Above Taiwan $14k / Maldives $16k; comparable to Saudi $18k. Tagged low.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. Wages ~1.15x SG (captain $55k vs $48k - French social charges pull total cost above SG); commercial electricity ~1.52x SG ($0.32 vs $0.21). R7-EXT services tariff applied. R7 two-sided: HIGH French-overseas crew (Code du Travail / CSG + 50% social charges) AND HIGH diesel-island electricity → blended ~0.90, second-highest in set (just below SG 1.00, above UAE 0.74 / Taiwan 0.72). FP is a high-income French collectivity, NOT a Pacific low-cost band.

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled India marine crew — between Indonesia $12k and Thailand $24k; PR #58 corridor pass

energy_usd_kwh.source: India commercial tariff blended ~₹8-10/kWh

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Coal-heavy India grid ~0.65-0.72

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled jetty/ferry-terminal overhead India coastal

captain_usd_yr.source: ERI Economic Research Institute ship-captain salary page for India (last updated 2026-06-20): average ship captain pay INR 1,588,602/yr, range INR 1,102,490-1,934,917. Converted at ~INR85/USD gives ~$18.7k average; model rounds to $19k/yr for India coastal passenger-vessel captain baseline. Deckhand/terminal staff are handled outside this country reference where applicable; source is salary-survey/commercial, not official wage order.

energy_usd_kwh.source: India Climate and Energy Dashboard (NITI/official-source aggregator) FY25: average cost of supply ₹7.10/kWh and average revenue ₹7.04/kWh; commercial billing-rate range shown ₹4.06-₹14.72/kWh, industrial range ₹3.43-₹13.69/kWh. Converted at ~INR85/USD: all-India average ~$0.083/kWh; use $0.085/kWh as blended commercial/marina charging baseline.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Climatiq factor sourced to Government of India / Central Electricity Authority Baseline Carbon Dioxide Emission Database v20.0: India grid weighted average electricity supplied from grid = 0.727 kgCO2e/kWh, year/release 2024; CO2-only partial-factor caveat noted.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth/insurance/admin/vessel-year. J.M. Baxi marina overview states Kochi International Marina is India’s first/only fully fledged international-standard marina, 36 berths expanding to 50, with fuel/water/electricity/sewage/maintenance; India still lacks widespread world-class marina supply and many boats use existing port berths. Use low-confidence $10k/yr, comparable to Indonesia/Philippines/Vietnam bands and below Thailand/Malaysia until market-specific marina quotes are captured.

cost_index.source: Blended India operating-cost index vs Singapore=1.00. Captain salary ~$19k vs Singapore $48k (~0.40x); energy $0.085 vs Singapore $0.21 (~0.40x); marina overhead modeled $10k vs Singapore $20k (0.50x). Weighted blend with Mumbai/Goa/Kochi port friction and premium operations uplift gives 0.50. Replace with city-specific opex once direct marina/crew/charging quotes are sourced.
